intro.pl: Dekorator wiąże metodę HTTP i adres z korutyną. FastAPI automatycznie koduje zwrócony słownik jako JSON.
intro.en: A decorator binds an HTTP method and URL to a coroutine. FastAPI automatically encodes returned dictionaries as JSON.

forecast.pl: Klient wyśle trzy GET: /, /time i /random. Router wybierze inną funkcję dla każdego adresu. Funkcja przygotuje słownik; FastAPI odeśle JSON.
forecast.en: The client sends three GET requests: /, /time and /random. The router selects a different function for each URL. That function prepares a dictionary; FastAPI sends JSON.

pipeline.pl: GET → router → korutyna → słownik → JSON
pipeline.en: GET → router → coroutine → dictionary → JSON

takeaway.pl: Zobaczysz Hello, czas UTC i losową liczbę od 1 do 100. Każde żądanie zakończy się HTTP 200.
takeaway.en: Expect Hello, UTC time and a random integer from 1 to 100. All requests return HTTP 200.

watch.pl: Najpierw przewidź odpowiedzi. Pokaz wyśle prawdziwe żądania HTTP, sprawdzi statusy i pokaże dane wejścia/wyjścia.
watch.en: Predict responses first. The demo sends real HTTP requests, verifies statuses and displays input/output.

question.en: Does @app.get execute the function during import?

answer.pl: Nie. Rejestruje trasę. Funkcja zostaje wywołana dopiero po pasującym żądaniu.
answer.en: No. It registers the route. The function runs after a matching request.

from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

app = FastAPI(
    title="Book Workshop",
    description="An educational book API",
    version="1.0.0",
)


class Book(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(examples=["Python Basics"])


@app.post(
    "/books", response_model=Book, tags=["books"], summary="Create a book"
)
async def create_book(book: Book):
    """Accept a title, for example Python Basics, and echo validated data."""
    return book

from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

app = FastAPI(
    title="Book Workshop",
    description="An educational book API",
    version="1.0.0",
)


class Book(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(examples=["Python Basics"])


@app.post(
    "/books", response_model=Book, tags=["books"], summary="Create a book"
)
async def create_book(book: Book):
    """Accept a title, for example Python Basics, and echo validated data."""
    return book

body.pl: raise przerywa bieżący przebieg. HTTPException stanie się odpowiedzią błędu; ValueError wewnątrz walidatora stanie się błędem walidacji 422. W transakcji wyjątek powoduje rollback. Przerywa endpoint odpowiedzią o podanym statusie i detail; dalsze instrukcje tej gałęzi nie wykonają się.
body.en: raise interrupts execution. HTTPException becomes an error response; ValueError in a validator becomes validation error 422. An exception inside a transaction triggers rollback. Stops the endpoint with the given status and detail; remaining statements in this branch do not run.

from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr, Field

app = FastAPI()


class Author(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=2)
    email: EmailStr


class Book(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1)
    author: Author
    price: float = Field(gt=0)


@app.post("/books")
async def create_book(book: Book):
    return book

main.py.source:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel, EmailStr, Field

app = FastAPI()


class Author(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=2)
    email: EmailStr


class Book(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1)
    author: Author
    price: float = Field(gt=0)


@app.post("/books")
async def create_book(book: Book):
    return book

question.en: Is flush a commit?

answer.pl: Nie. flush wysyła SQL; poprawne wyjście z begin zatwierdza transakcję.

from demo_support import database_lifespan, get_db
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from sqlalchemy import Integer, String, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class Book(Base):
    __tablename__ = "books"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100))
    price: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer)
    category: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), default="Books")


class BookCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)
    price: int = Field(gt=0, le=1000000)
    category: str = Field(default="Books", max_length=40)


class BookRead(BookCreate):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
    id: int


app = FastAPI(lifespan=database_lifespan(Base))


@app.post("/books", response_model=BookRead, status_code=201)
async def create_book(data: BookCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    async with db.begin():
        book = Book(**data.model_dump())
        db.add(book)
        await db.flush()
    return book


@app.get("/books", response_model=list[BookRead])
async def list_books(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    result = await db.execute(select(Book).order_by(Book.id))
    return result.scalars().all()


@app.get("/books/{book_id}", response_model=BookRead)
async def get_book(book_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    book = await db.get(Book, book_id)
    if book is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Book not found")
    return book


@app.put("/books/{book_id}", response_model=BookRead)
async def replace_book(
    book_id: int, data: BookCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    async with db.begin():
        book = await db.get(Book, book_id)
        if book is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Book not found")
        book.title = data.title
        book.price = data.price
        book.category = data.category
    return book


@app.delete("/books/{book_id}", status_code=204)
async def delete_book(book_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    async with db.begin():
        book = await db.get(Book, book_id)
        if book is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Book not found")
        await db.delete(book)
    return Response(status_code=204)

from demo_support import database_lifespan, get_db
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey, String, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import (
    DeclarativeBase,
    Mapped,
    mapped_column,
    relationship,
    selectinload,
)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class Author(Base):
    __tablename__ = "authors"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100))
    books: Mapped[list["Book"]] = relationship(back_populates="author")


class Book(Base):
    __tablename__ = "books"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100))
    author_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("authors.id"))
    author: Mapped[Author] = relationship(back_populates="books")


class BookRead(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
    id: int
    title: str


class AuthorCreate(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)


class BookCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)
    author_id: int


app = FastAPI(lifespan=database_lifespan(Base))


@app.post("/authors", status_code=201)
async def create_author(data: AuthorCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    async with db.begin():
        author = Author(**data.model_dump())
        db.add(author)
        await db.flush()
    return {"id": author.id, "name": author.name}


@app.post("/books", status_code=201)
async def create_book(data: BookCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    async with db.begin():
        if await db.get(Author, data.author_id) is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Author not found")
        book = Book(**data.model_dump())
        db.add(book)
        await db.flush()
    return {"id": book.id, "title": book.title}


@app.get("/authors/{author_id}/books", response_model=list[BookRead])
async def author_books(author_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    statement = (
        select(Author)
        .options(selectinload(Author.books))
        .where(Author.id == author_id)
    )
    author = (await db.execute(statement)).scalar_one_or_none()
    if author is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Author not found")
    return author.books

from demo_support import database_lifespan, get_db
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey, String, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import (
    DeclarativeBase,
    Mapped,
    mapped_column,
    relationship,
    selectinload,
)


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class Author(Base):
    __tablename__ = "authors"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100))
    books: Mapped[list["Book"]] = relationship(back_populates="author")


class Book(Base):
    __tablename__ = "books"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100))
    author_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("authors.id"))
    author: Mapped[Author] = relationship(back_populates="books")


class BookRead(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
    id: int
    title: str


class AuthorCreate(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)


class BookCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)
    author_id: int


app = FastAPI(lifespan=database_lifespan(Base))


@app.post("/authors", status_code=201)
async def create_author(data: AuthorCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    async with db.begin():
        author = Author(**data.model_dump())
        db.add(author)
        await db.flush()
    return {"id": author.id, "name": author.name}


@app.post("/books", status_code=201)
async def create_book(data: BookCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    async with db.begin():
        if await db.get(Author, data.author_id) is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Author not found")
        book = Book(**data.model_dump())
        db.add(book)
        await db.flush()
    return {"id": book.id, "title": book.title}


@app.get("/authors/{author_id}/books", response_model=list[BookRead])
async def author_books(author_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    statement = (
        select(Author)
        .options(selectinload(Author.books))
        .where(Author.id == author_id)
    )
    author = (await db.execute(statement)).scalar_one_or_none()
    if author is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Author not found")
    return author.books

import asyncio
import json
import time
import uuid

from demo_support import runtime_file
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request

app = FastAPI()
log_lock = asyncio.Lock()


@app.middleware("http")
async def log_request(request: Request, call_next):
    request_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
    started = time.perf_counter()
    response = await call_next(request)
    response.headers["X-Request-ID"] = request_id
    entry = {
        "method": request.method,
        "path": request.url.path,
        "seconds": time.perf_counter() - started,
        "request_id": request_id,
    }
    async with log_lock:
        await asyncio.to_thread(append_log, entry)
    return response


def append_log(entry):
    with runtime_file("requests.log").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        stream.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")


@app.get("/books")
async def list_books():
    return {"books": []}

import asyncio
import json
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager

from demo_support import database_lifespan, runtime_file
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from lab_support import event
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app):
    async with database_lifespan(Base)(app):
        cache_file = runtime_file("cache.json")
        cached = (
            await asyncio.to_thread(cache_file.read_text, encoding="utf-8")
            if cache_file.exists()
            else "{}"
        )
        app.state.cache = json.loads(cached)
        event("log", "cache", "STARTUP: cache loaded")
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            await asyncio.to_thread(
                cache_file.write_text,
                json.dumps(app.state.cache),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            event("log", "cache", "SHUTDOWN: cache saved")


app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)


@app.get("/cache")
async def get_cache(request: Request):
    return request.app.state.cache


@app.put("/cache/{key}")
async def put_cache(key: str, value: str, request: Request):
    request.app.state.cache[key] = value
    return request.app.state.cache

from demo_support import database_lifespan, runtime_file
from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
from lab_support import event
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app):
    async with database_lifespan(Base)(app):
        cache_file = runtime_file("cache.json")
        cached = (
            await asyncio.to_thread(cache_file.read_text, encoding="utf-8")
            if cache_file.exists()
            else "{}"
        )
        app.state.cache = json.loads(cached)
        event("log", "cache", "STARTUP: cache loaded")
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            await asyncio.to_thread(
                cache_file.write_text,
                json.dumps(app.state.cache),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            event("log", "cache", "SHUTDOWN: cache saved")


app = FastAPI(lifespan=lifespan)


@app.get("/cache")
async def get_cache(request: Request):
    return request.app.state.cache


@app.put("/cache/{key}")
async def put_cache(key: str, value: str, request: Request):
    request.app.state.cache[key] = value
    return request.app.state.cache

from demo_support import database_lifespan, get_db
from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, HTTPException, Query, Response
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from sqlalchemy import Integer, String, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class Book(Base):
    __tablename__ = "books"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100))
    price: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer)
    category: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), default="Books")


class BookCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)
    price: int = Field(gt=0, le=1000000)
    category: str = Field(default="Books", max_length=40)


class BookRead(BookCreate):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
    id: int


app = FastAPI(lifespan=database_lifespan(Base))


@app.post("/books", response_model=BookRead, status_code=201)
async def create_book(data: BookCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    async with db.begin():
        book = Book(**data.model_dump())
        db.add(book)
        await db.flush()
    return book


@app.get("/books", response_model=list[BookRead])
async def list_books(
    skip: int = Query(0, ge=0),
    limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),
    category: str | None = None,
    min_price: int = Query(0, ge=0),
    max_price: int | None = Query(None, ge=0),
    sort_by: str = "price",
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    if max_price is not None and min_price > max_price:
        raise HTTPException(400, "Invalid price range")
    if sort_by not in {"price", "title"}:
        raise HTTPException(400, "Unknown sort field")
    statement = select(Book).where(Book.price >= min_price)
    if max_price is not None:
        statement = statement.where(Book.price <= max_price)
    if category is not None:
        statement = statement.where(Book.category == category)
    order = Book.price if sort_by == "price" else Book.title
    statement = statement.order_by(order, Book.id).offset(skip).limit(limit)
    result = await db.execute(statement)
    return result.scalars().all()


@app.get("/books/{book_id}", response_model=BookRead)
async def get_book(book_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    book = await db.get(Book, book_id)
    if book is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Book not found")
    return book


@app.put("/books/{book_id}", response_model=BookRead)
async def replace_book(
    book_id: int, data: BookCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    async with db.begin():
        book = await db.get(Book, book_id)
        if book is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Book not found")
        book.title = data.title
        book.price = data.price
        book.category = data.category
    return book


@app.delete("/books/{book_id}", status_code=204)
async def delete_book(book_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    async with db.begin():
        book = await db.get(Book, book_id)
        if book is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Book not found")
        await db.delete(book)
    return Response(status_code=204)

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from sqlalchemy import Integer, String, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class Book(Base):
    __tablename__ = "books"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100))
    price: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer)
    category: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(40), default="Books")


class BookCreate(BaseModel):
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=100)
    price: int = Field(gt=0, le=1000000)
    category: str = Field(default="Books", max_length=40)


class BookRead(BookCreate):
    model_config = ConfigDict(from_attributes=True)
    id: int


app = FastAPI(lifespan=database_lifespan(Base))


@app.post("/books", response_model=BookRead, status_code=201)
async def create_book(data: BookCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    async with db.begin():
        book = Book(**data.model_dump())
        db.add(book)
        await db.flush()
    return book


@app.get("/books", response_model=list[BookRead])
async def list_books(
    skip: int = Query(0, ge=0),
    limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),
    category: str | None = None,
    min_price: int = Query(0, ge=0),
    max_price: int | None = Query(None, ge=0),
    sort_by: str = "price",
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    if max_price is not None and min_price > max_price:
        raise HTTPException(400, "Invalid price range")
    if sort_by not in {"price", "title"}:
        raise HTTPException(400, "Unknown sort field")
    statement = select(Book).where(Book.price >= min_price)
    if max_price is not None:
        statement = statement.where(Book.price <= max_price)

    order = Book.price if sort_by == "price" else Book.title
    statement = statement.order_by(order, Book.id).offset(skip).limit(limit)
    result = await db.execute(statement)
    return result.scalars().all()


@app.get("/books/{book_id}", response_model=BookRead)
async def get_book(book_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    book = await db.get(Book, book_id)
    if book is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Book not found")
    return book


@app.put("/books/{book_id}", response_model=BookRead)
async def replace_book(
    book_id: int, data: BookCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    async with db.begin():
        book = await db.get(Book, book_id)
        if book is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Book not found")
        book.title = data.title
        book.price = data.price
        book.category = data.category
    return book


@app.delete("/books/{book_id}", status_code=204)
async def delete_book(book_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    async with db.begin():
        book = await db.get(Book, book_id)
        if book is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Book not found")
        await db.delete(book)
    return Response(status_code=204)

forecast.pl: Dodamy Annę i Jana. Anna utworzy post. Jan spróbuje go edytować, potem doda komentarz. Odczyt pobierze post z komentarzami; zadanie w tle zapisze powiadomienie.

takeaway.pl: Edycja Jana da 403, edycja Anny 200. Komentarz trafi do zagnieżdżonej odpowiedzi i email.log. Końcowe DELETE i GET potwierdzą usunięcie. Klucze są wyłącznie demonstracyjne.

question.pl: Czy ID autora podaje klient w JSON posta?
question.en: Does the client supply author ID in post JSON?

answer.pl: Nie. Autor pochodzi z dependency rozpoznającej użytkownika, więc JSON nie może podszyć się pod innego autora.
answer.en: No. Author identity comes from the dependency, so JSON cannot impersonate another author.

caveat.pl: Pokaz działa lokalnie, w osobnym procesie i z własnymi danymi. PostgreSQL jest prawdziwy; mail i AI są symulowane. Klucze demonstracyjne nie stanowią pełnego systemu logowania. BackgroundTasks nie gwarantuje trwałej kolejki.

from fastapi import Header, HTTPException, Request
from models import User

DEMO_KEYS = {"demo-anna-key": 1, "demo-jan-key": 2}


async def get_actor(
    request: Request, x_api_key: Annotated[str | None, Header()] = None
):
    user_id = DEMO_KEYS.get(x_api_key)
    if user_id is None:
        raise HTTPException(401, "Use a demonstration API key")
    async with request.app.state.sessions() as session:
        user = await session.get(User, user_id)
        if user is None:
            raise HTTPException(401, "Demo user does not exist")
        return user.id

from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column, relationship


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), unique=True)


class Post(Base):
    __tablename__ = "posts"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100))
    body: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(5000))
    user_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="CASCADE")
    )
    comments: Mapped[list["Comment"]] = relationship(
        back_populates="post", passive_deletes=True
    )


class Comment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "comments"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    body: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(1000))
    user_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="CASCADE")
    )
    post_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("posts.id", ondelete="CASCADE")
    )
    post: Mapped[Post] = relationship(back_populates="comments")

from auth import get_actor
from demo_support import get_db, runtime_file
from fastapi import APIRouter, BackgroundTasks, Depends, HTTPException, Response
from lab_support import event
from models import Comment, Post
from schemas import CommentCreate, PostCreate
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession
from sqlalchemy.orm import selectinload

router = APIRouter(prefix="/posts", tags=["posts"])


def post_data(post):
    return {
        "id": post.id,
        "title": post.title,
        "body": post.body,
        "user_id": post.user_id,
    }


def notify_author(post_id):
    with runtime_file("email.log").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        stream.write(f"New comment on post {post_id}; email simulated\n")
    event("log", "background", "Author notification recorded")


@router.post("", status_code=201)
async def create_post(
    data: PostCreate,
    actor: int = Depends(get_actor),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    async with db.begin():
        post = Post(**data.model_dump(), user_id=actor)
        db.add(post)
        await db.flush()
    return post_data(post)


@router.get("")
async def list_posts(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    posts = (await db.execute(select(Post).order_by(Post.id))).scalars().all()
    return [post_data(post) for post in posts]


@router.get("/{post_id}")
async def get_post(post_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    post = await db.get(Post, post_id)
    if post is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Post not found")
    return post_data(post)


@router.put("/{post_id}")
async def replace_post(
    post_id: int,
    data: PostCreate,
    actor: int = Depends(get_actor),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    async with db.begin():
        post = await db.get(Post, post_id)
        if post is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Post not found")
        if post.user_id != actor:
            raise HTTPException(403, "Only the author may edit")
        post.title = data.title
        post.body = data.body
    return post_data(post)


@router.delete("/{post_id}", status_code=204)
async def delete_post(
    post_id: int,
    actor: int = Depends(get_actor),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    async with db.begin():
        post = await db.get(Post, post_id)
        if post is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Post not found")
        if post.user_id != actor:
            raise HTTPException(403, "Only the author may delete")
        await db.delete(post)
    return Response(status_code=204)


@router.post("/{post_id}/comments", status_code=201)
async def add_comment(
    post_id: int,
    data: CommentCreate,
    background_tasks: BackgroundTasks,
    actor: int = Depends(get_actor),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    async with db.begin():
        if await db.get(Post, post_id) is None:
            raise HTTPException(404, "Post not found")
        comment = Comment(body=data.body, post_id=post_id, user_id=actor)
        db.add(comment)
        await db.flush()
    background_tasks.add_task(notify_author, post_id)
    return {"id": comment.id, "body": comment.body}


@router.get("/{post_id}/with-comments")
async def post_with_comments(post_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    statement = (
        select(Post)
        .options(selectinload(Post.comments))
        .where(Post.id == post_id)
    )
    post = (await db.execute(statement)).scalar_one_or_none()
    if post is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "Post not found")
    return {
        **post_data(post),
        "comments": [{"id": c.id, "body": c.body} for c in post.comments],
    }

from auth import get_actor
from demo_support import get_db
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Response
from models import User
from schemas import UserCreate
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

router = APIRouter(prefix="/users", tags=["users"])


@router.post("", status_code=201)
async def create_user(data: UserCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    async with db.begin():
        user = User(**data.model_dump())
        db.add(user)
        await db.flush()
    return {"id": user.id, "name": user.name}


@router.get("")
async def list_users(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    users = (await db.execute(select(User).order_by(User.id))).scalars().all()
    return [{"id": user.id, "name": user.name} for user in users]


@router.get("/{user_id}")
async def get_user(user_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    user = await db.get(User, user_id)
    if user is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "User not found")
    return {"id": user.id, "name": user.name}


@router.put("/{user_id}")
async def replace_user(
    user_id: int,
    data: UserCreate,
    actor: int = Depends(get_actor),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    if actor != user_id:
        raise HTTPException(403, "Only the account owner may edit")
    async with db.begin():
        user = await db.get(User, user_id)
        user.name = data.name
    return {"id": user.id, "name": user.name}


@router.delete("/{user_id}", status_code=204)
async def delete_user(
    user_id: int,
    actor: int = Depends(get_actor),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    if actor != user_id:
        raise HTTPException(403, "Only the account owner may delete")
    async with db.begin():
        user = await db.get(User, user_id)
        await db.delete(user)
    return Response(status_code=204)

quick.name: Uruchomienie i middleware / Startup and middleware

body.pl: Aplikacja dołącza routery i zarządza PostgreSQL przez lifespan. Konflikty bazy stają się 409. W zadaniu 20 middleware sprawdza body przed endpointem.
body.en: The app includes routers and manages PostgreSQL via lifespan. Database conflicts become 409. In task 20 middleware checks the body before endpoints.

body.pl: Demonstracyjny klucz wskazuje ID konta. Osobna sesja potwierdza istnienie użytkownika. Brak klucza lub użytkownika daje 401. Zmiana nazwy konta nie zmienia jego ID.
body.en: A demo key maps to an account ID. A separate session checks the user exists. Missing keys or users give 401. Renaming an account does not change its ID.

quick.name: Tabele i relacje / Tables and relationships

body.pl: User → Post → Comment są powiązane kluczami obcymi. Post.comments udostępnia kolekcję; kasowanie w bazie usuwa zależne rekordy.
body.en: Foreign keys connect User → Post → Comment. Post.comments exposes the collection; database deletes remove dependent rows.

quick.name: Tworzenie i odczyt / Create and read

body.pl: Autor pochodzi z dependency. Zapis jest w transakcji; odczyty zwracają słowniki JSON.
body.en: The dependency supplies authorship. Writes use a transaction; reads return JSON dictionaries.

quick.name: Edycja i usuwanie / Edit and delete

body.pl: Przed zmianą porównujemy post.user_id z actor. Cudzy użytkownik dostanie 403; właściciel może zmienić lub usunąć post.
body.en: Compare post.user_id with actor before changing anything. Other users get 403; the owner can edit or delete.

quick.name: Komentarze i eager loading / Comments and eager loading

body.pl: Komentarz zapisujemy przed zaplanowaniem powiadomienia. selectinload pobiera kolekcję do zagnieżdżonego JSON bez leniwego I/O.
body.en: Save the comment before scheduling notification. selectinload fetches the collection for nested JSON without lazy I/O.

body.pl: Powiadomienie trafia do pliku po odpowiedzi HTTP. W zadaniu 20 reguła great/bad zapisuje również symulowany sentyment.

body.pl: Router obsługuje tworzenie, listę, odczyt, zmianę i usuwanie. Zmiana i usunięcie wymagają właściciela konta.
body.en: The router implements create, list, read, update and delete. Changes and deletion require account ownership.

body.pl: Modele Pydantic ograniczają długości tekstów. JSON posta nie zawiera user_id: autor zostanie ustalony po kluczu.

intro.pl: Dodajemy trzy punkty rozszerzenia: podsumowanie, analizę w tle i middleware moderacji. Algorytmy są jawnie uproszczone.
intro.en: Add three extension points: summarization, background analysis and moderation middleware. Algorithms are explicitly simplified.

forecast.pl: Na bazie bloga pobierzemy pierwszych 12 słów posta jako symulację podsumowania. Komentarz z great dostanie pozytywny sentyment. forbiddenword zostanie odrzucone przed zapisem.
forecast.en: On top of the blog, return the first 12 post words as a summary simulation. A comment containing great receives positive sentiment. Reject forbiddenword before saving.

pipeline.pl: Middleware treści → blog → symulacja podsumowania → analiza w tle
pipeline.en: Content middleware → blog → summary simulation → background analysis

takeaway.pl: Odpowiedź podsumowania ma mode: local simulation. sentiment.jsonl pokaże positive; blokowana treść da 400. Nie ma zewnętrznego modelu, kosztów API ani prawdziwej moderacji AI.
takeaway.en: Summary output labels local simulation. sentiment.jsonl shows positive; blocked content gives 400. No external model, API cost or real AI moderation is involved.

watch.pl: Najpierw przewidź odpowiedzi. Pokaz wyśle prawdziwe żądania HTTP, sprawdzi statusy i pokaże dane wejścia/wyjścia.
watch.en: Predict responses first. The demo sends real HTTP requests, verifies statuses and displays input/output.

question.pl: Czy to pokaz jakości modelu AI?
question.en: Is this a demonstration of AI model quality?

answer.pl: Nie. Ćwiczymy architekturę i przepływ danych; reguły celowo nie udają pełnego modelu ani skutecznej ochrony treści.
answer.en: No. We exercise architecture and data flow; rules deliberately do not pretend to be a full model or effective content protection.

caveat.pl: Pokaz działa lokalnie, w osobnym procesie i z własnymi danymi. PostgreSQL jest prawdziwy; mail i AI są symulowane. Klucze demonstracyjne nie stanowią pełnego systemu logowania. BackgroundTasks nie gwarantuje trwałej kolejki.
caveat.en: The demo runs locally in a separate process with its own data. PostgreSQL is real; email and AI are simulated. Demo keys are not a complete authentication system. BackgroundTasks is not a durable queue.

from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import Header, HTTPException, Request
from models import User

DEMO_KEYS = {"demo-anna-key": 1, "demo-jan-key": 2}


async def get_actor(
    request: Request, x_api_key: Annotated[str | None, Header()] = None
):
    user_id = DEMO_KEYS.get(x_api_key)
    if user_id is None:
        raise HTTPException(401, "Use a demonstration API key")
    async with request.app.state.sessions() as session:
        user = await session.get(User, user_id)
        if user is None:
            raise HTTPException(401, "Demo user does not exist")
        return user.id

from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import DeclarativeBase, Mapped, mapped_column, relationship


class Base(DeclarativeBase):
    pass


class User(Base):
    __tablename__ = "users"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), unique=True)


class Post(Base):
    __tablename__ = "posts"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(100))
    body: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(5000))
    user_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="CASCADE")
    )
    comments: Mapped[list["Comment"]] = relationship(
        back_populates="post", passive_deletes=True
    )


class Comment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "comments"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    body: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(1000))
    user_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("users.id", ondelete="CASCADE")
    )
    post_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(
        ForeignKey("posts.id", ondelete="CASCADE")
    )
    post: Mapped[Post] = relationship(back_populates="comments")

from auth import get_actor
from demo_support import get_db
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Response
from models import User
from schemas import UserCreate
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

router = APIRouter(prefix="/users", tags=["users"])


@router.post("", status_code=201)
async def create_user(data: UserCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    async with db.begin():
        user = User(**data.model_dump())
        db.add(user)
        await db.flush()
    return {"id": user.id, "name": user.name}


@router.get("")
async def list_users(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    users = (await db.execute(select(User).order_by(User.id))).scalars().all()
    return [{"id": user.id, "name": user.name} for user in users]


@router.get("/{user_id}")
async def get_user(user_id: int, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)):
    user = await db.get(User, user_id)
    if user is None:
        raise HTTPException(404, "User not found")
    return {"id": user.id, "name": user.name}


@router.put("/{user_id}")
async def replace_user(
    user_id: int,
    data: UserCreate,
    actor: int = Depends(get_actor),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    if actor != user_id:
        raise HTTPException(403, "Only the account owner may edit")
    async with db.begin():
        user = await db.get(User, user_id)
        user.name = data.name
    return {"id": user.id, "name": user.name}


@router.delete("/{user_id}", status_code=204)
async def delete_user(
    user_id: int,
    actor: int = Depends(get_actor),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
):
    if actor != user_id:
        raise HTTPException(403, "Only the account owner may delete")
    async with db.begin():
        user = await db.get(User, user_id)
        await db.delete(user)
    return Response(status_code=204)

body.pl: Klasa UserCreate dziedziczy po BaseModel. BaseModel definiuje dane wejściowe/wyjściowe Pydantic; Base lub DeclarativeBase dotyczą tabel ORM. Tych dwóch rodzajów modeli nie należy utożsamiać.
body.en: UserCreate inherits BaseModel. BaseModel defines Pydantic input/output data; Base or DeclarativeBase defines ORM tables. These are different kinds of models.

steps.name: L5 · Pole i typ / Field and type

body.pl: Pole `name` ma deklarowany typ `str`. W Pydantic ta deklaracja służy walidacji i dokumentacji; Mapped opisuje atrybut ORM. Brak wartości domyślnej w BaseModel oznacza pole wymagane. Określa reguły pola, np. długość tekstu, zakres liczby i przykłady do dokumentacji.
body.en: Field `name` declares type `str`. Pydantic uses it for validation and docs; Mapped describes an ORM attribute. No default in BaseModel means a required field. Defines field rules such as text length, number bounds and documentation examples.

quick.name: Uruchomienie i middleware / Startup and middleware

body.pl: Aplikacja dołącza routery i zarządza PostgreSQL przez lifespan. Konflikty bazy stają się 409. W zadaniu 20 middleware sprawdza body przed endpointem.
body.en: The app includes routers and manages PostgreSQL via lifespan. Database conflicts become 409. In task 20 middleware checks the body before endpoints.

body.pl: Demonstracyjny klucz wskazuje ID konta. Osobna sesja potwierdza istnienie użytkownika. Brak klucza lub użytkownika daje 401. Zmiana nazwy konta nie zmienia jego ID.
body.en: A demo key maps to an account ID. A separate session checks the user exists. Missing keys or users give 401. Renaming an account does not change its ID.

quick.name: Tabele i relacje / Tables and relationships

body.pl: User → Post → Comment są powiązane kluczami obcymi. Post.comments udostępnia kolekcję; kasowanie w bazie usuwa zależne rekordy.
body.en: Foreign keys connect User → Post → Comment. Post.comments exposes the collection; database deletes remove dependent rows.

quick.name: Tworzenie i odczyt / Create and read

body.pl: Autor pochodzi z dependency. Zapis jest w transakcji; odczyty zwracają słowniki JSON.
body.en: The dependency supplies authorship. Writes use a transaction; reads return JSON dictionaries.

quick.name: Edycja i usuwanie / Edit and delete

body.pl: Przed zmianą porównujemy post.user_id z actor. Cudzy użytkownik dostanie 403; właściciel może zmienić lub usunąć post.
body.en: Compare post.user_id with actor before changing anything. Other users get 403; the owner can edit or delete.

quick.name: Komentarze i eager loading / Comments and eager loading

body.pl: Komentarz zapisujemy przed zaplanowaniem powiadomienia. selectinload pobiera kolekcję do zagnieżdżonego JSON bez leniwego I/O.
body.en: Save the comment before scheduling notification. selectinload fetches the collection for nested JSON without lazy I/O.

body.pl: Powiadomienie trafia do pliku po odpowiedzi HTTP. W zadaniu 20 reguła great/bad zapisuje również symulowany sentyment.
body.en: Notification is written to a file after the HTTP response. In task 20 a great/bad rule also records simulated sentiment.

body.pl: Pierwszych 12 słów tworzy lokalną symulację. Pole mode jasno informuje, że nie używamy modelu językowego.
body.en: The first 12 words form a local simulation. mode clearly states that no language model is used.

body.pl: Router obsługuje tworzenie, listę, odczyt, zmianę i usuwanie. Zmiana i usunięcie wymagają właściciela konta.
body.en: The router implements create, list, read, update and delete. Changes and deletion require account ownership.

body.pl: Modele Pydantic ograniczają długości tekstów. JSON posta nie zawiera user_id: autor zostanie ustalony po kluczu.
body.en: Pydantic models constrain text lengths. Post JSON contains no user_id: the key determines its author.
